{{Quote|Garto wants revenge on me&mdash;on our clan!''"<br />"''Revenge for ''what'', father?''"<br />"''For what Garto would have done to me first if he'd had the chance!|Volnos Ryo and his daughter, Tasha Ryo|<ref name="DOTJ 2" />}}
[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] '''Garto''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|head]] of one the [[Nine Houses]], the crime families that ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]], and a rival of Baron [[Volnos Ryo]] in [[Clan Ryo]]. Sometime before [[25,793 BBY]], Ryo dealt a blow against Garto, earning Garto's enmity, and in revenge Garto hired the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Jaris Kan]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Volnos Ryo, though Kan ultimately failed in [[Assassination attempt on Baron Volnos Ryo|his attempt]].<ref name="DOTJ 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garto was mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DOTJ 2" /> on [[March 21]], [[2012]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/18-027/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-2|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi #2}}</ref>
